liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Foolish Heart** (3 reviews): Reviewer calls the Ship of Fools, Dark Star, Drums, Foolish Heart stretch of set two mind-blowing; Reviewer loves Foolish Heart emerging from Space, calling it an unusual slot [23][25][30]
- **Standing On the Moon** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls it huge, with Jerry's final crazy midi-fied solos nearly melting their head; Reviewer considers it the highlight of the show [29][30]
- **Let The Good Times Roll** (1 review): Reviewer says the opener followed by Feel Like A Stranger rivals the best pairings, such as Alpine Valley '89 [33]
- **Big Railroad Blues** (1 review): Reviewer hears Bruce all over this song, as well as Beat It On Down the Line and All Over Now [25]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): Reviewer finds this Dark Star odd but nice [29]

## The recordings

- **gd91-09-24.sbd.allred.2374.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 169 min; rated 4.33/5 by 6 [1]
- **gd1991-09-24.150638.sbd.pearson-healy.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 21 songs; 173 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1991-09-24.sbd.serafin.tetzeli.fix-7693.33813.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 168 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd91-09-24.sbd.miller.25939.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 173 min; rated 3.89/5 by 8 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer considers this transfer a definite upgrade over the other source on the page; Reviewer describes the recording and remaster as good [24][32]
- **gd1991-09-24.sbd.miller.tetzeli.fix-25939.35363.reflac.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 172 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [5]

## Around the show

- Reviewer found the first set slow, with Garcia seeming out of it [23]
- Reviewer says it was their last show at the Garden [23]
- Reviewer's first Dead show, attended at age 13 with an uncle, who had backstage passes via Zildjian [26]
- Reviewer met Mickey Hart backstage, who urged them to go out and experience things for themselves [26]
- Reviewer stood second row in front of Phil; Jerry looked over his glasses toward them while singing [29]
- A video of this show circulates on DVD, with a somewhat shaky camera [31]
- Reviewer ranks the 1991 Boston run among the best shows they saw the band play [24]
- Reviewer counts this first set among their 1990s favorites and says the band never let up across six Boston shows [25]
- Reviewer calls these Boston shows the best of 1991 and likes Hornsby's contribution here [33]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd91-09-24.sbd.allred.2374.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > MC > DAT > CDR [1]
- **gd1991-09-24.150638.sbd.pearson-healy.miller.flac2496**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  September 30, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [2]. Also: Several masters were combined to make the show complete [2]
- **gd1991-09-24.sbd.serafin.tetzeli.fix-7693.33813.flac16**: transferred by fix of 7693 by Bill Tetzeli; source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Redone fix makes the CD 2 to CD 3 transition seamless and uses shntool to repair SBEs; Seekable-problem SHNs converted to FLAC, with Drums and Space split into separate tracks; Jay supplied the unfaded overlap [3]
- **gd91-09-24.sbd.miller.25939.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> Dat x 3 [4]
- **gd1991-09-24.sbd.miller.tetzeli.fix-25939.35363.reflac.flac16**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: Fix of shnid 25939 [5]. Also: Redundant material between CDs 2 and 3 was removed; SHNs converted to FLAC and SBEs cleaned with shntool [5]
